senses.definition: n.pr.m. (cf. inscr. in RA 1867, pl. 7, DrSm xxiii; Nö ZMG 1886, 162 ‘pointing ֵto avoid offence;’ but Nbr Acad. 1887, Dec. 17 comp. Talm & 𝔗 (חַזּוּרָא, חֵיזוּר, חֲזוּרָא etc.) pomegranate (and apple; Syriac ܚܰܙܘܽܪ, ܚܰܙܘܽܪܳܐ), cf. בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן 2 S 4:2, 5, 9)—
a priest of 17th course (assigned to David’s time) 1 Ch 24:15; 𝔊 Χηζειν (16th, v 14), but A Ιεζειρ, 𝔊L Χηζειρ.
one of those sealed Ne 10:21; 𝔊 Ηζειρ, 𝔊L Αζηρ.
